tools.name: get_service_overview
tools.description: Describe the purpose, scope and recommended use of the Sortition Knowledge MCP service.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Semantically search the Sortition knowledge base. Use this for questions about sortition, citizens' assemblies, citizens' chambers, democratic institutions and related reforms. Returns relevant source excerpts with document name, page and score.

tools.name: list_documents
tools.description: List the source documents currently available in the Sortition knowledge base.

tools.name: get_document_page
tools.description: Retrieve the complete text of one page from a PDF source document. Use this after search_knowledge() when more context or source verification is needed.
